deploy-bot: Build pipeline started for tag release/v1.12.0 on staging · commit 9f3b2c1 · matrix: linux/py310, mac/py310, lint, e2e · URL https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/2938007654
lucy: heads up, queue length is 6 right now, saw concurrent-build-throttle kicking in :thinking:
ash: thanks. which job failed last time? lint or e2e?
deploy-bot: Job update: lint failed on job #12 with exit code 2. Tests still running.
ash: copying lint output: ```/workspace/src/core/model_serving.py:120:5: F401 'numpy as np' imported but unused
E302 expected 2 blank lines, found 1
error: command failed with exit code 1``` Could be strict flake8 config.
devex: that F401 might be from generated code. We should add # noqa or adjust exported file. But for release we can pin the base image to python:3.10-slim with older flake8?
sara: pinning sounds risky. Can we fastpatch the import cleanup instead? small PR makes lint green.
qa-bot: e2e suite showing 2 flaky failures in chrome headless (timeout on autocomplete). Not correlated to lint.
release-manager: we need decision: continue with queue (might delay deploy by 45m) or hold and pin to v1.11.8 for immediate rollback. What's impact on SLA?
mike: customer-facing change is minor; but we promised the change window for tonight. If hold, we'll miss window. I'd prefer to roll forward if lint can be fixed quickly.
ash: I can push a lint-fix PR in 15min. But build concurrency throttle might re-run tests in different worker, so we should cancel stale queued builds.
devex: propose: cancel queued runs except one, run quick lint-fix PR, then if green, allow deploybot to resume. If lint still fails, pin to v1.11.8 and open hotfix branch.
release-manager: approved. ash, go ahead. Sara, QA keep an eye on e2e flakies.
ash: creating branch hotfix/lint-9f3b2c1 and PR -> https://git.redwood.dev/r/repo/pulls/4823
deploy-bot: Build update: lint job retried for PR 4823, currently running on node g4dn.xlarge.
lucy: FYI I cleared 4 queued jobs to free capacity. (reaction :thumbsup:)
deploy-bot: PR build success. lint passed. Integration jobs starting.
qa-bot: quick smoke passed on staging. e2e still running.
deploy-bot: e2e matrix: 2/3 passed, 1 flaky timeout retried.
deploy-bot: e2e retry passed. Full matrix green. Deploy to staging scheduled at 23:30 UTC.
release-manager: marking release as proceed. rolling to canary at 00:00 UTC. I'll update release notes and changelog.
mike: add note about the lint fix in changelog and mention regressions monitoring.
ash: will merge PR and tag release/v1.12.0 once canary looks good.
devex: FYI re: pin plan — if we had pinned base image earlier we might have avoided new lints; adding to retrospective.
lucy: thanks all. closing thread once deploy finishes.
deploy-bot: Deploy complete to staging (tag release/v1.12.0, commit 9f3b2c1). Canary rollout scheduled. Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/2938007654/logs
